close_reason: Verified in code — implementation matches decision exactly.
description: The MDN/send handler validates that onSuccessUpdateEmail is present and sets keywords/$mdnsent: true for every entry in send, before invoking the backend. This means no MdnBackend implementation can accidentally send an MDN without the keyword being stamped — the invariant is enforced in one place regardless of how many backends exist. Oracle: draft-ietf-jmap-mdn-17 §2.1 (server MUST reject if patch is absent or wrong).
title: DECISION: Handler enforces onSuccessUpdateEmail/ before calling backend
